pages.quiz:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the correct spelling of the colour of a ripe banana? (1 mark)
   A. yelllow
   B. yelow
   C. yeloww
   D. yellow

2. Which word is a definite article? (1 mark)
   A. the
   B. some
   C. a
   D. an

3. Which tense is best for telling the story? (1 mark)
   A. future tense only
   B. a new tense in each line
   C. no tense
   D. past tense

4. What is fertilizer used for? (1 mark)
   A. To store water
   B. To help plants grow
   C. To kill birds
   D. To dig the soil

5. Which quantifier goes with an uncountable noun in a question? (1 mark)
   A. several
   B. few
   C. much
   D. many

6. Which is an object pronoun? (1 mark)
   A. him
   B. I
   C. he
   D. his

7. Which is an opinion, not a fact? (1 mark)
   A. Soap helps to remove germs.
   B. Cold water is the nicest to drink.
   C. Boiled water is safer than untreated river water.
   D. Germs are too small to see.

8. A person in your family who lived long before your grandparents is an (1 mark)
   A. ancestor
   B. widow
   C. orphan
   D. elder

9. What is a chorus in a song? (1 mark)
   A. The first word
   B. The last verse only
   C. The part repeated after each verse
   D. The name of the singer

10. What is the plural of 'knife'? (1 mark)
   A. knifes
   B. knifees
   C. knives
   D. knifs

11. On a map, the four main directions are (1 mark)
   A. up, down, left and right
   B. front, back, near and far
   C. north, south, east and west
   D. red, blue, green and yellow

12. What does proofreading mean? (1 mark)
   A. Writing a new composition
   B. Checking your work for mistakes
   C. Counting the pages
   D. Reading only the title

13. What is the past participle of 'go'? (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. gone

14. How does your voice usually change at the end of a question? (1 mark)
   A. It becomes silent
   B. It stays flat
   C. It goes up
   D. It goes down

15. Which word has a silent w? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. window
   C. write
   D. week

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Complete the sentences: (a) We have enough plates ___ (eat) the meal. (b) There is enough rice ___ (feed) the guests. (2 marks)

17. Tell in three sentences how to set up a reading club. (3 marks)

18. Write two minimal pairs for /t/ and /d/. (2 marks)

19. List three details that a school library form may ask for. (3 marks)

20. Give two differences between a friendly letter and an SMS. (2 marks)

21. Write three ways to make your speech clearer. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — yellow
   Yellow has a double l.

2. A — the
   The is the definite article.

3. D — past tense
   Stories are usually told in the past tense.

4. B — To help plants grow
   Fertilizer adds nutrients to soil.

5. C — much
   How much water?

6. A — him
   Him is the object form of he.

7. B — Cold water is the nicest to drink.
   An opinion says what someone thinks.

8. A — ancestor
   Ancestors are family members from long ago.

9. C — The part repeated after each verse
   The chorus is repeated.

10. C — knives
   Change fe to ves.

11. C — north, south, east and west
   These are called the cardinal points.

12. B — Checking your work for mistakes
   Proofread for spelling, capitals and punctuation.

13. D — gone
   Go, went, gone.

14. C — It goes up
   A question ends with a rising voice.

15. C — write
   In 'write' the w is silent.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: (a) to eat (b) to feed
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Agree on a regular time and a quiet place. Each member reads a book they have chosen. Take turns to tell the group about it and keep a list of the books read.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible sentence.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: ten, den and tin, din.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Name, grade, date of birth, school name, address, class teacher, head teacher (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A letter is longer and has five parts, but an SMS is short and has a receiver, a message and a sender. A letter is better for news and feelings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each difference.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Open your mouth enough; speak slowly at first; listen to a good model and copy them; practise every day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.
